items.title: Santo Pecora Interview, 1972-11-09
items.q: No, just with Tony Almerico. I played, you know, but a long time ago when I was 17 years old... I played on the boat, you know, two bands

ctx.x: That's a special. Oh, you mentioned the Capitol. You played on the Capitol with different bands?

No, just with Tony Almerico. I played, you know, but a long time ago when I was 17 years old, 15, 16, 17 years old, I played on the boat, you know, two bands, they had two bands, a colored band, you know, Marble?
